span.p:
TIER 0 · Full
audio + vision + packaging + fix + re-scan + self-cert
target state, Monday night

div.style: color: rgb(26, 46, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TIER 1 · No vision
vision API down or over budget
banner: 'visual pass unavailable'
audio findings still fix and re-scan

div.style: color: rgb(66, 32, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TIER 2 · No ASR API
Groq down → OpenAI Whisper fallback
→ local faster-whisper via python subprocess

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TIER 3 · No network at all
judge-mode only: 3 cached sample clips
full report, real fixed.mp4 files, real re-scan
this is what you demo from

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TIER 4 · Saturday kill switch
loop not working end-to-end?
cut vision permanently, ship audio-only, polish

span.p:
Never show the judge a spinner or a stack trace.
Every failure has a visible, labelled degraded state.
Record the demo from Tier 3 so latency and rate limits
can never break it on camera.
